conversions.name: resonate_grid_crystal
conversions.why: The resonator turns one redstone dust into one grid crystal using Grid Power, which has no EMC (a custom recipe type the EMC mods cannot map).

recipe_processes.name: resonating
recipe_processes.why: Every resonating recipe, including datapack additions, must not create EMC: Grid Power is free once built, so a recipe worth more out than in would be an infinite EMC loop.

notes: Generators turn items into Forge Energy / Team Reborn Energy, not items, so they need no EMC process. Grid Power is a rate shared per player or team and is never stored in an item.
